hooks.name: Sensitive File Protector
hooks.description: Prevents writing to sensitive files like .env, secrets.json, and credential files.
hooks.longDescription: This hook intercepts Write and Edit operations to protect sensitive files containing secrets, API keys, and credentials from accidental modifications or exposure.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Command Whitelist
hooks.description: Restricts bash commands to a pre-approved whitelist for enhanced security.
hooks.longDescription: Configure a list of allowed bash commands and block any execution attempts outside this whitelist. Perfect for production environments with strict security policies.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: External API Blocker
hooks.description: Blocks network requests to unauthorized domains to prevent data leakage.
hooks.longDescription: Monitor and control all external API calls made during Claude's operations. Define allowed domains and block everything else to ensure data stays within your organization.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Auto Prettier
hooks.description: Automatically formats code using Prettier after every Write or Edit operation.
hooks.longDescription: This hook ensures consistent code formatting across your project by running Prettier immediately after Claude makes changes. Integrates seamlessly with your existing Prettier configuration.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: ESLint Validator
hooks.description: Validates code against ESLint rules before allowing commits.
hooks.longDescription: Run ESLint checks on modified files before they are committed. Prevents code that violates your linting rules from entering the repository.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Type Check Enforcer
hooks.description: Runs TypeScript type checks automatically after code modifications.
hooks.longDescription: Ensure type safety by running tsc --noEmit after every code change. Catches type errors immediately before they cause runtime issues.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Git Auto-Commit
hooks.description: Automatically commits changes after successful edits with generated commit messages.
hooks.longDescription: Streamline your git workflow by automatically creating commits after Claude completes file modifications. Uses AI to generate meaningful commit messages based on changes.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Test Runner
hooks.description: Runs your test suite automatically after code changes to ensure nothing breaks.
hooks.longDescription: Execute your test suite (Jest, Vitest, etc.) after every code modification. Get immediate feedback on whether changes break existing functionality.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Build Validator
hooks.description: Ensures your project builds successfully after modifications.
hooks.longDescription: Run your build command (npm run build, etc.) after code changes to verify the project still compiles. Catches build errors before they reach CI/CD.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Audit Logger
hooks.description: Logs all tool executions to an audit trail for compliance and debugging.
hooks.longDescription: Maintain a comprehensive audit log of every action Claude takes. Essential for compliance requirements, security audits, and troubleshooting.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: License Checker
hooks.description: Validates that dependencies have approved licenses before installation.
hooks.longDescription: Automatically scan package licenses when dependencies are added. Blocks packages with non-compliant licenses to ensure legal compliance.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Change Request Tracker
hooks.description: Links code changes to JIRA tickets or GitHub issues for traceability.
hooks.longDescription: Enforce ticket-based development by requiring issue numbers for all changes. Automatically links commits and changes to your project management system.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Slack Notifier
hooks.description: Sends Slack notifications when Claude completes sessions or encounters errors.
hooks.longDescription: Stay informed about Claude's activities with real-time Slack notifications. Configure alerts for session completion, errors, or specific events.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Context Compactor
hooks.description: Intelligently manages session context to prevent token limit issues.
hooks.longDescription: Automatically compress and optimize conversation context before hitting token limits. Uses smart algorithms to preserve important information while reducing context size.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Environment Switcher
hooks.description: Auto-configures environment variables based on the current project context.
hooks.longDescription: Automatically load the correct environment configuration when switching between projects. Supports multiple environments (dev, staging, prod) per project.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Smart Stop
hooks.description: Uses LLM to intelligently determine if Claude should continue working.
hooks.longDescription: Leverage AI to decide when Claude should stop and ask for clarification versus continuing work. Reduces unnecessary back-and-forth while maintaining quality.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Session Summarizer
hooks.description: Creates a summary of work completed when sessions end.
hooks.longDescription: Generate comprehensive summaries of what Claude accomplished during each session. Perfect for daily standups, progress tracking, and documentation.
hooks.author: claude-hooks

hooks.name: Quick Deploy
hooks.description: Triggers deployment pipelines after successful builds.
hooks.longDescription: Automatically kick off deployment to staging or production after builds pass. Integrates with Vercel, Netlify, AWS, and other deployment platforms.
hooks.author: claude-hooks
